scope: Frozen before measuring any aerial image. This file records a protocol, not results.
corpus: USC SIPI aerials, all twelve native 512x512 color images 2.1.01 through 2.1.12
selection: Publisher-listed native dimensions and color type only; no crops, resizing, previews, or result-based exclusions. The 1024x1024 and 2250x2250 images are outside this validation's compute budget.
prior_known_inputs: Kodak 01-03 development; all 14 SIPI miscellaneous color images now regressions

learned.precision_scope: Power-of-two-grid rounding of hidden/head weight matrices only, unchanged guide, affine, and biases. Binary16 model tensors remain in-band.
learned.format: self-contained integer NNEX v2 with SHA-256 raw RGB checksum

selection_rule: Encode all eight learned candidates, verify each independently, choose the smallest complete file against the actual wrapped SCDX. Keep floor on ties.
baselines: Exact RGB PNG (Pillow optimize), WebP lossless cwebp -z 9 -exact, native JPEG XL lossless effort 9, numthreads 1; verify every round-trip
reporting: All twelve images, complete files including transmitted model and headers, per-image and aggregate bytes, exact RGBA verification, hashes. No adaptive tuning during this cohort. Runtime under concurrent workers is not isolated latency.
limitations: One small aerial corpus, not broad proof or maximum-strength coverage of all existing codecs. Production defaults remain unchanged.
